about: Episode 4 of EPISODES.md as a tour: a long document flips the winner between the DGX Spark and the Mac Studio. Qwen3.8 27B at 4-bit, the question prompt, then the document. The Mac's wider bus wins the writing, the Spark's GPU wins the reading. Every number comes from labs/data through the mission's metrics.
title: The Mac beats my Spark, until I paste a document

steps.title: A quick question: the Mac wins
text: Writing is memory work, and the Mac's wide bus moves {bw}.
It writes {writeTps} and is done in {doneS}.
steps.metaphor: Think of it as a wide fuel line: more fuel per second, more words per second.

breakIt.label: make it 16-bit
breakIt.caption: More bytes per word: even the wide bus slows down.

steps.caption: A quick question: the Mac is done in {doneS:mac}.

steps.title: The Spark falls behind
text: Its bus moves {bw}, against the Mac's {bw:mac}, so each word waits longer.
steps.metaphor: Think of it as the same engine on a narrower fuel line.

breakIt.label: use the 35B MoE
breakIt.caption: A model that reads less per word: the Spark speeds up.

steps.caption: Same question: the Spark needs {doneS:spark}.

steps.title: Now paste a 30-page document
text: Reading a long prompt is math, not memory: every GPU block works at once.
The whole document is in after {readS}.
steps.metaphor: Think of it as a sprinter: the race is short, so the engine counts.

breakIt.label: paste a whole codebase
breakIt.caption: Four times the reading: the GPU sprints for longer.

steps.caption: Reading is math. The Spark reads {readTps:spark}.

steps.title: The Mac's GPU reads slower
text: {The} has the faster bus but less GPU math.
It reads {readTps}, so the document takes {readS} before the first word.
Its faster writing can't win that back: done in {doneS}.
steps.metaphor: Think of it as a truck with a huge tank and a small engine, stuck on a hill.

breakIt.label: back to the question
breakIt.caption: A short prompt: the Mac's reading hardly matters.

steps.caption: The Mac reads at {readTps:mac}. The winner flips.

steps.title: Mission Report
text: The same document on five machines.
Between the Spark and the Mac the winner flips; the graphics cards win both rounds.
steps.metaphor: Think of it as a race with two legs: one for the engine, one for the fuel line.

breakIt.label: back to the question
breakIt.caption: The question again: the Mac is back in front of the Spark.

steps.caption: Next: I gave my idle GPU 32 jobs.
